_about: Short forms for the <title> tag only, for entries whose title is too long even without the name suffix.
The limit is 65 characters: Bing Site Scan flagged titles over 71 as too long, and Google truncates near 60.
The h1, og:title and structured data keep the full title from the sheet.
'for' is the sheet title each was written for. If the sheet title changes, the short form is ignored with
a warning from tools/generate-entry-pages.py, rather than silently titling the page with stale words.
